summary.en: The lock-up: name and version (amber when it is the answer), the tagline, the install command typing; the ground flips once more on the last downbeat.
summary.zh: 落版：名字和版本号（版本是答案时为琥珀色）、标语、安装命令打出来；最后一个强拍上底色再翻一次。

fits: The closing of a query film: the product that answered, and how to get it.
notFor: A film that ends on a claim or a reveal (use answer-whiteout as the close); a name without a command.

intent.en: The answer gets a name and a way in: the name stands still, the command types out and holds long enough to copy, the last flip closes the rhythm.
intent.zh: 答案有了名字和入口：名字不动，命令打出来并停留到够人抄下，最后一次翻底收住节奏。

content.en: A name (≤ 12 chars), an optional version (≤ 6), a tagline (≤ 34 chars), an install command (≤ 34 chars of code).
content.zh: 名字（≤ 6 字）、可选版本号、一句标语（≤ 14 字）、安装命令（≤ 34 个字符的代码）。

fits.zh: 提问式片子的收尾：给出答案的产品，以及怎么用上它。

notFor.zh: 以主张或揭晓收尾的片子；没有命令的名字。

pairs.note: the figures before it, through runtime slice-smear

en: The version is amber only when it is the search's answer (`answer: true`).
Hold the typed command at least 3 s.
zh: 只有版本号就是检索答案时才用琥珀色（`answer: true`）。
命令打完至少停 3 秒。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
